fullPassage:
Consumer Activism

Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions to support or protest certain products or companies based on their ethical, environmental, or social concerns. A boycott is a form of protest in which individuals stop purchasing products from a particular company to express their objection to its practices. For example, in 2010, Greenpeace, an environmental support organization, initiated a campaign against a product of a food company, accusing the company of sourcing palm oil from companies involved in the destruction of forests. In response to Greenpeace's campaign and growing public pressure, the company agreed to cease sourcing palm oil from companies linked with the destruction of forests and commit to using sustainable palm oil by 2015.

Today, a new form of consumer activism, known as a buycott, has emerged. In a buycott, consumers actively support companies in accord with their values by consciously buying their products. In 2020, an ice cream brand gained attention for its support of climate action. Consumers who shared this value actively purchased the ice cream, enhancing its reputation and sales. This inspired other brands to consider their social and environmental responsibilities.

In this way, consumer activism empowers individuals to use their purchasing power and voices to promote positive change and hold businesses accountable for their actions.

questions.passage: Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions to support or (A)[protest / praise] certain products or companies based on their ethical, environmental, or social concerns. A boycott is a form of protest in which individuals stop purchasing products from a (B)[particular / random] company to express their objection to its practices. In response to Greenpeace's campaign and growing public pressure, the company agreed to cease sourcing palm oil from companies linked with the (C)[destruction / construction] of forests and commit to using sustainable palm oil by 2015.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 소비자 운동은 특정 제품이나 기업에 대해 항의(protest)하거나 지지하는 행동이다. 보이콧은 특정(particular) 회사의 제품 구매를 중단하는 것이며, 기업은 삼림 파괴(destruction)와 관련된 야자유 공급을 중단하기로 합의했다.
det.analysis:
① protest — particular — destruction: 원문과 일치. ←정답

② praise — particular — construction: praise(칭찬)는 항의 맥락과 반대.

③ protest — random — construction: random(무작위)은 특정 기업 맥락과 불일치.

④ praise — random — destruction: praise와 random 모두 부적절.

questions.passage: For example, in 2010, Greenpeace, an environmental support organization, (A)[initiated / terminated] a campaign against a product of a food company, accusing the company of sourcing palm oil from companies involved in the destruction of forests. Today, a new form of consumer activism, known as a buycott, has emerged. In a buycott, consumers actively support companies in accord with their values by (B)[consciously / carelessly] buying their products. This inspired other brands to consider their social and environmental (C)[responsibilities / privileges].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 그린피스는 캠페인을 시작했다(initiated). 바이콧에서 소비자들은 의식적으로(consciously) 제품을 구매한다. 이는 다른 브랜드들에게 사회적·환경적 책임(responsibilities)을 고려하도록 영감을 주었다.
det.analysis:
① terminated — consciously — privileges: terminated(종료)는 캠페인 시작 맥락과 반대.

② initiated — carelessly — responsibilities: carelessly(부주의하게)는 의식적 구매와 반대.

③ initiated — consciously — responsibilities: 원문과 일치. ←정답

④ terminated — carelessly — privileges: 세 단어 모두 부적절.

questions.passage: Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions to support or protest certain products or companies based on their (A)[ethical / unethical], environmental, or social concerns. In response to Greenpeace's campaign and growing public pressure, the company agreed to cease sourcing palm oil from companies linked with the destruction of forests and commit to using (B)[sustainable / disposable] palm oil by 2015. In this way, consumer activism (C)[empowers / restricts] individuals to use their purchasing power and voices to promote positive change and hold businesses accountable for their actions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 소비자 운동은 윤리적(ethical) 관심에 기반한다. 기업은 지속 가능한(sustainable) 야자유 사용을 약속했다. 소비자 운동은 개인에게 구매력을 사용할 힘을 부여한다(empowers).
det.analysis:
① unethical — sustainable — restricts: unethical(비윤리적)은 소비자의 관심 맥락과 반대.

② ethical — sustainable — empowers: 원문과 일치. ←정답

③ ethical — disposable — restricts: disposable(일회용)은 지속 가능성과 반대.

④ unethical — disposable — empowers: unethical과 disposable 모두 부적절.

questions.passage: Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions to support or protest certain products or companies based on their ethical, environmental, or social ①<u>concerns</u>. A boycott is a form of protest in which individuals stop purchasing products from a particular company to express their ②<u>approval</u> to its practices. For example, in 2010, Greenpeace, an environmental support organization, initiated a campaign against a product of a food company, ③<u>accusing</u> the company of sourcing palm oil from companies involved in the ④<u>destruction</u> of forests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 보이콧은 기업의 관행에 대한 반대(objection)를 표현하는 것이다. approval(승인)은 반대 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ① concerns(우려): 원문 그대로.

✅ ② purchasing(구매하는): 원문 그대로.

❌ ③ approval(승인): 원문은 objection(반대). 보이콧은 항의이므로 승인은 부적절. ←정답

✅ ④ destruction(파괴): 원문 그대로.

questions.passage: Today, a new form of consumer activism, known as a buycott, has ①<u>emerged</u>. In a buycott, consumers actively support companies in accord with their values by consciously buying their products. In 2020, an ice cream brand gained attention for its support of climate action. Consumers who shared this value actively purchased the ice cream, enhancing its ②<u>reputation</u> and sales. This ③<u>inspired</u> other brands to consider their social and environmental ④<u>liabilities</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 다른 브랜드들에게 사회적·환경적 책임(responsibilities)을 고려하도록 영감을 주었다. liabilities(부채/법적 책임)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① emerged(등장했다): 원문 그대로.

✅ ② reputation(평판): 원문 그대로.

✅ ③ inspired(영감을 주었다): 원문 그대로.

❌ ④ liabilities(부채): 원문은 responsibilities(책임). 사회적 책임 맥락에서 liabilities는 부적절. ←정답

questions.passage: Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions to support or protest certain products or companies based on their ethical, environmental, or social concerns. A boycott is a form of protest in which individuals stop ①<u>purchasing</u> products from a particular company to express their objection to its practices. In response to Greenpeace's campaign and growing public pressure, the company ②<u>refused</u> to cease sourcing palm oil from companies linked with the destruction of forests and commit to using ③<u>sustainable</u> palm oil by 2015. In this way, consumer activism empowers individuals to use their purchasing power and voices to ④<u>promote</u> positive change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 기업은 야자유 공급 중단에 합의했다(agreed). refused(거부했다)는 반대 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ① purchasing(구매하는): 원문 그대로.

❌ ② refused(거부했다): 원문은 agreed(합의했다). 대중 압력에 합의한 것. ←정답

✅ ③ sustainable(지속 가능한): 원문 그대로.

✅ ④ promote(촉진하다): 원문 그대로.

questions.passage:

Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions to support or protest certain products or companies based on their ethical, environmental, or social concerns. A boycott is a form of protest in which individuals stop purchasing products from a particular company to express their objection to its __________. For example, in 2010, Greenpeace, an environmental support organization, initiated a campaign against a product of a food company, accusing the company of sourcing palm oil from companies involved in the destruction of forests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 개인들은 특정 회사의 관행(practices)에 대한 반대를 표현하기 위해 구매를 중단한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① practices(관행): 원문 일치. objection to its practices. ←정답

❌ ② campaigns(캠페인): 캠페인은 그린피스의 행동.

❌ ③ products(제품): 제품이 아닌 관행에 반대.

❌ ④ values(가치): 가치는 바이콧 맥락에서 사용됨.
det.tip: practices = 관행, 관례. objection to = ~에 대한 반대.

questions.passage: For example, in 2010, Greenpeace, an environmental support organization, initiated a campaign against a product of a food company, accusing the company of __________ palm oil from companies involved in the destruction of forests. In response to Greenpeace's campaign and growing public pressure, the company agreed to cease sourcing palm oil from companies linked with the destruction of forests and commit to using sustainable palm oil by 2015.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기업이 삼림 파괴에 관련된 회사로부터 야자유를 조달(sourcing)한다고 비난했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① producing(생산하는): 생산이 아닌 조달.

❌ ② exporting(수출하는): 수출이 아닌 조달.

❌ ③ recycling(재활용하는): 야자유 재활용은 문맥 불일치.

✅ ④ sourcing(조달하는): 원문 일치. cease sourcing과 대응. ←정답

questions.passage: Today, a new form of consumer activism, known as a buycott, has emerged. In a buycott, consumers actively support companies in accord with their values by consciously buying their products. In 2020, an ice cream brand gained __________ for its support of climate action. Consumers who shared this value actively purchased the ice cream, enhancing its reputation and sales.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아이스크림 브랜드는 기후 행동 지지로 주목(attention)을 받았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① attention(관심): 원문 일치. gained attention. ←정답

❌ ② criticism(비판): 지지 활동에 비판은 부적절.

❌ ③ funding(자금): 관심을 받은 것이지 자금이 아님.

❌ ④ permission(허가): 문맥 불일치.

questions.passage: Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions to support or protest certain products or companies based on their ethical, environmental, or social concerns. A boycott is a form of protest in which individuals stop purchasing products from a particular company to express their objection to its practices. For example, in 2010, Greenpeace, an environmental support organization, <u>initiated</u> a campaign against a product of a food company.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 initiated와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: initiated = 시작했다(started).
det.analysis:
✅ ① started(시작했다): initiated의 동의어. ←정답

❌ ② completed(완료했다): 시작과 반대.

❌ ③ abandoned(포기했다): 시작과 반대.

❌ ④ delayed(지연시켰다): 시작과 다른 의미.

questions.passage: In response to Greenpeace's campaign and growing public pressure, the company agreed to <u>cease</u> sourcing palm oil from companies linked with the destruction of forests and commit to using sustainable palm oil by 2015.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 cease와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: cease = 중단하다(stop).
det.analysis:
❌ ① continue(계속하다): 중단과 반대.

❌ ② increase(증가시키다): 중단과 다른 의미.

❌ ③ begin(시작하다): 중단과 반대.

✅ ④ stop(멈추다): cease의 동의어. ←정답
det.tip: cease = stop = halt. 야자유 공급을 중단하다.

questions.passage: In this way, consumer activism empowers individuals to use their purchasing power and voices to <u>promote</u> positive change and hold businesses accountable for their actions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 promote와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: promote = 촉진하다(encourage).
det.analysis:
❌ ① prevent(방지하다): 촉진과 반대.

❌ ② ignore(무시하다): 촉진과 다른 의미.

✅ ③ encourage(장려하다): promote의 동의어. ←정답

❌ ④ oppose(반대하다): 촉진과 반대.
det.tip: promote = encourage = foster. 긍정적 변화를 촉진하다.

questions.passage: In this way, consumer activism empowers individuals to use their purchasing power and voices to promote <u>positive</u> change and hold businesses accountable for their actions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 positive와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: positive(긍정적인)의 반의어 = negative(부정적인).
det.analysis:
✅ ① negative(부정적인): positive의 반의어. ←정답

❌ ② active(적극적인): 반의어가 아님.

❌ ③ constructive(건설적인): 유사어에 가까움.

❌ ④ significant(중요한): 관계없는 의미.

questions.passage: In response to Greenpeace's campaign and <u>growing</u> public pressure, the company agreed to cease sourcing palm oil from companies linked with the destruction of forests and commit to using sustainable palm oil by 2015.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 growing과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: growing(증가하는)의 반의어 = declining(감소하는).
det.analysis:
❌ ① expanding(확장하는): growing의 유사어.

❌ ② rising(상승하는): growing의 유사어.

✅ ③ declining(감소하는): growing의 반의어. ←정답

❌ ④ spreading(퍼지는): growing의 유사어.

questions.passage:
(A) Greenpeace initiated a <u>campaign</u> against a product of a food company, accusing the company of sourcing palm oil from companies involved in the destruction of forests.

(B) The marketing team launched a new advertising <u>campaign</u> to boost sales of the holiday gift sets during the winter season.
questions.stem: 다음 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 campaign의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A)에서 campaign은 환경 사회 운동이고, (B)에서는 판매 촉진을 위한 광고 활동이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 광고 활동 — (B) 사회 운동: 의미가 뒤바뀜.

❌ ② (A) 군사 작전 — (B) 광고 활동: (A)는 환경 운동.

❌ ③ (A) 사회 운동 — (B) 군사 작전: (B)는 광고.

✅ ④ (A) 사회 운동 — (B) 광고 활동: 맞는 짝. ←정답
det.tip: campaign은 다의어: 사회 운동(social campaign) / 광고 활동(advertising campaign) / 군사 작전(military campaign).

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"able to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting natural resources"

det.korean: 자연 자원을 고갈시키지 않고 유지할 수 있는 = sustainable(지속 가능한).
det.analysis:
❌ ① ethical(윤리적인): 도덕적 원칙에 관한 것.

❌ ② environmental(환경의): 환경에 관한 것이지 지속 가능성이 아님.

❌ ③ accountable(책임이 있는): 책임에 관한 것.

✅ ④ sustainable(지속 가능한): 영영 정의와 일치. ←정답
det.tip: sustainable = 지속 가능한. maintain + without depleting = 고갈 없이 유지.

questions.passage: In response to Greenpeace's campaign, the company agreed to stop its harmful practices. The __________ (destroy) of forests is a major environmental concern.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

overlay.excerptSentences: In response to Greenpeace's campaign, the company agreed to stop its harmful practices. The __________ (destroy) of forests is a major environmental concern.

det.korean: 삼림의 파괴(destruction)는 주요 환경 문제이다.
det.analysis: The + __________ → 명사 자리. destroy(동사) → destruction(명사).

questions.passage: Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions based on their ethical concerns. Consumers are becoming more __________ (conscious) of how their purchases affect the environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

overlay.excerptSentences: Consumer activism involves consumers taking actions based on their ethical concerns. Consumers are becoming more __________ (conscious) of how their purchases affect the environment.

det.korean: 소비자들은 자신의 구매가 환경에 미치는 영향에 대해 더 의식하게(conscious) 되고 있다.
det.analysis: more + __________ → 형용사 자리. conscious는 이미 형용사이므로 그대로 사용.
det.tip: become more conscious of = ~을 더 의식하게 되다. conscious(형용사) → consciously(부사), consciousness(명사).
